usedFor: Judge.me holds product reviews, and Google Sheets keeps the numbers through “Update Spreadsheet Row” after “Updated All Reviews Rating”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated All Reviews Rating” in Judge.me, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: The rating change updates one sheet row, so a team sees the current figure without opening the review tool.

watchOut: Judge.me sends this event to a webhook URL, so “Updated All Reviews Rating” needs that URL and your shop.
